{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print("Data shape:", data.shape)
print("\nFirst few rows:")
print(data.head())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
sentinel_count = (data['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum()
print(f"\nNumber of sentinel values (-999) in biomarker_baseline: {sentinel_count}")

# Check for duplicates in patient_id
duplicate_count = data['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f"Number of duplicate patient_id entries: {duplicate_count}")

# Check the unique values in assay_batch to confirm unit issue
print(f"Unique assay_batch values: {data['assay_batch'].unique()}")"}
